messages.content: What is the current time in New York City?

message.content:
I don’t have access to live clocks, so I can’t give you the exact minute‑by‑minute time right now.  
New York City is in the **Eastern Time Zone (ET)**:

| Time zone | UTC offset | Typical daylight‑saving rule |
|-----------|------------|------------------------------|
| Eastern Standard Time (EST) | –5 h | Nov – Mar |
| Eastern Daylight Time (EDT) | –4 h | Mar – Nov |

If you know the current UTC time, just subtract 4 hours (during daylight saving) or 5 hours (outside of it) to get the local time in NYC.  
For the most accurate result, check a reliable world‑clock website, your phone’s clock, or a smart‑assistant device.
